fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después del día en que planees salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared, or the money could be seized when you leave.
entry.es: Debes declarar efectivo o cheques de viajero por 10.000 euros o más; si no, el dinero podría ser confiscado al salir.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more. You will get a certified declaration to show you brought it in with you. If you do not, your money could be seized when you leave.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.
entry.es: No se pueden llevar carne, leche ni productos que los contengan a países de la UE.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

entry.en: In private accommodation you must notify the police within 3 working days of arrival; hotels do this for you.
entry.es: En alojamiento privado debes avisar a la policía en un plazo de 3 días hábiles tras llegar; los hoteles lo hacen por ti.
entry.quote: If you are in private accommodation, you must notify the police by letter, email or in person within 3 working days of your arrival.

safety.en: There is a risk of petty crime, especially in Bratislava, where pickpockets operate in main tourist areas, Christmas markets and bars.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de delitos menores, sobre todo en Bratislava, donde operan carteristas en zonas turísticas, mercadillos navideños y bares.
safety.quote: There is a risk of petty crime, especially in Bratislava. Take precautions against pickpockets and bag snatchers and do not leave your possessions unattended. Pickpockets operate around the main tourist areas, particularly the Christmas markets and in bars

safety.en: There is a risk of drink spiking and theft in clubs around Bratislava Old Town, and drinks have sometimes been extortionately priced.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de que adulteren bebidas y de robos en locales del casco antiguo de Bratislava, y a veces se han cobrado precios abusivos.
safety.quote: There is a risk of drink spiking and theft in clubs around the Bratislava Old Town pedestrian area. People have sometimes been charged extortionate prices for drinks, so check prices before ordering

safety.en: Brown bears are present in many mountain and forested areas, so hikers should stay on marked trails and make noise in forests.
safety.es: Hay osos pardos en muchas zonas de montaña y bosque, por lo que conviene seguir los senderos marcados y hacer ruido en el bosque.
safety.quote: Brown bears are present in many mountain and forested areas, particularly in central and northern Slovakia, including parts of the Tatras, Low Tatras and Poľana areas. Bear sightings and occasional attacks have been reported. If hiking, stay on marked trails, avoid dense vegetation where visibility

safety.en: On Slovak motorways you must display a motorway vignette on the windscreen, or you could get a heavy fine.
safety.es: En las autopistas eslovacas debes mostrar una viñeta en el parabrisas o podrías recibir una multa elevada.
safety.quote: If you use Slovak motorways (‘Dialnica’), you must display a motorway vignette (sticker) on the inside of your windscreen as you enter Slovakia. If you do not, you could get a heavy fine.

safety.en: You must always carry your passport as ID, with a fine of up to 1,600 euros for not showing it if police ask.
safety.es: Debes llevar siempre el pasaporte como identificación; no mostrarlo a la policía puede costar hasta 1.600 euros de multa.
safety.quote: You must always carry your passport with you as ID. You can get a fine of up to 1,600 euros for not showing ID if the Slovak police ask for it.

safety.en: Drinking alcohol in the street in Bratislava Old Town is illegal and could bring a fine of 33 euros.
safety.es: Beber alcohol en la calle en el casco antiguo de Bratislava es ilegal y puede suponer una multa de 33 euros.
safety.quote: In Bratislava Old Town, it is illegal to drink alcohol in the street. If you drink alcohol (for example, bought in a supermarket) in this or other public areas, you could get a fine of 33 euros.

health.en: FCDO notes an increased risk of tick bites in Slovakia from April to October.
health.es: El FCDO señala un mayor riesgo de picaduras de garrapatas en Eslovaquia de abril a octubre.
health.quote: See what health risks you’ll face in Slovakia, including an increased risk of tick bites from April to October.

health.en: For medically necessary state healthcare in Slovakia, UK travellers need a GHIC or EHIC.
health.es: Para recibir atención sanitaria estatal médicamente necesaria en Eslovaquia hace falta una tarjeta GHIC o EHIC.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Slovakia, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: Tap water is drinkable everywhere in Slovakia, according to Wikivoyage.
health.es: Según Wikivoyage, el agua del grifo es potable en todo Eslovaquia.

health.en: Medicines are not sold in supermarkets or drug stores in Slovakia, so even aspirin must be bought at a pharmacy.
health.es: En Eslovaquia no se venden medicamentos en supermercados ni droguerías; hasta la aspirina se compra en una farmacia.
health.quote: There are no over-the-counter drugs sold in Slovakia in supermarkets or drug stores, you will need to head to a pharmacy

health.en: No vaccination is necessary for Slovakia, though a tick vaccination is recommended if you visit the countryside.
health.es: No se exige vacuna para Eslovaquia, aunque se recomienda la vacuna contra garrapatas si visitas el campo.
health.quote: No vaccination is necessary to visit or stay in Slovakia, although if you plan to visit countryside areas, a tick vaccination is recommended.

help.en: Slovakia emergency numbers are ambulance 155, fire 150 and police 158.
help.es: Números de emergencia en Eslovaquia: ambulancia 155, bomberos 150 y policía 158.

help.en: In an emergency in Slovakia you can dial 112, the universal European emergency number.
help.es: En una emergencia en Eslovaquia puedes marcar el 112, el número europeo de emergencias.
help.quote: In case of an emergency, dial 112, the universal European emergency number.

help.en: The Mountain Rescue Service can be reached on 18300 or 112 in an emergency.
help.es: Al servicio de rescate de montaña se le puede llamar al 18300 o al 112 en una emergencia.
help.quote: In the event of an emergency they can be contacted by dialing 18300 or the universal 112.

getting_in.en: Vienna Airport (VIE), 37 km from Bratislava, is described as the best airport for reaching Slovakia, with hourly direct buses to Bratislava.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Viena (VIE), a 37 km de Bratislava, se describe como el mejor para llegar a Eslovaquia, con autobuses directos cada hora a Bratislava.
getting_in.quote: The best airport to get into Slovakia is Vienna Airport (VIE IATA), which is just 37 km (23 mi) from Bratislava and receives a great number of long-haul flights. Direct buses to Bratislava's main bus station depart from the airport hourly.

getting_in.en: Smaller international airports are Košice (KSC) and Poprad-Tatry (TAT).
getting_in.es: Otros aeropuertos internacionales más pequeños son Košice (KSC) y Poprad-Tatry (TAT).
getting_in.quote:
Smaller international airports are:

1 Košice international airport (KSC IATA): A small airport, with a small number of scheduled flights mainly from Vienna, Zurich, Warsaw, London Stansted and London Luton.
2 Poprad - Tatry (www.airport-poprad.sk; TAT IATA): Quite a small airport with 3 daily

getting_in.en: EC trains run every two hours from Prague to Bratislava and Žilina.
getting_in.es: Los trenes EC circulan cada dos horas de Praga a Bratislava y Žilina.
getting_in.quote: EC trains operate every two hours from Prague to Bratislava and Žilina.

getting_in.en: Hourly regional express trains run from Vienna to Bratislava.
getting_in.es: Trenes regionales exprés salen cada hora de Viena a Bratislava.
getting_in.quote: Hourly regional expresses operate from Vienna to Bratislava

getting_in.en: If you need a visa, apply at an embassy beforehand, as visas are not issued at the Slovak border.
getting_in.es: Si necesitas visa, solicítala antes en una embajada; no se emiten visas en la frontera eslovaca.
getting_in.quote: If you need a visa, always apply at an embassy beforehand. There is no chance you will get a visa at a Slovak border, no matter how you enter or what your nationality is.

getting_around.en: Train is described as by far the best way to travel across Slovakia if you have no private vehicle.
getting_around.es: Se describe el tren como la mejor opción para recorrer Eslovaquia si no tienes vehículo propio.
getting_around.quote: Train is by far the best option to travel across Slovakia, provided you don't have a private vehicle.

getting_around.en: InterCity trains link Bratislava, Žilina, the High Tatras and Košice and have compulsory reservations.
getting_around.es: Los trenes InterCity unen Bratislava, Žilina, los Altos Tatras y Košice y requieren reserva obligatoria.
getting_around.quote: IC trains link Bratislava, Žilina, The High Tatras and Košice and have compulsory reservations.

getting_around.en: Most bus tickets are bought from the driver, so you will probably need cash.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de los billetes de autobús se compran al conductor, así que probablemente necesitarás efectivo.
getting_around.quote: Most tickets are bought directly from the driver, so you will probably need cash.

getting_around.en: Ride-hailing is available in Slovakia, with Bolt in many towns and Uber in Bratislava.
getting_around.es: Hay transporte por aplicación en Eslovaquia: Bolt en muchas ciudades y Uber en Bratislava.
getting_around.quote:
Ride-hailing is available in Slovakia and the following are the most anticipated providers:

 Bolt. Includes many towns. (updated Jul 2020)
 Uber. Works in Bratislava.

getting_around.en: Headlights must be on at all times when driving in Slovakia, day or night.
getting_around.es: En Eslovaquia los faros deben llevarse encendidos siempre al conducir, de día y de noche.
getting_around.quote: Headlights must be switched on when driving at all times

getting_around.en: The motorway vignette is sold at most petrol stations and costs 10 euros for ten days or 14 euros for a month.
getting_around.es: La viñeta de autopista se vende en la mayoría de gasolineras: 10 euros por diez días o 14 euros por un mes.
getting_around.quote: The vignette can be purchased from most petrol stations and is valid for ten days (€10), for a month (€14) or longer.

money.quote: Slovakia uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: ATMs are widely available in Slovakia except in smaller villages.
money.es: Los cajeros automáticos abundan en Eslovaquia, salvo en los pueblos más pequeños.
money.quote: Automatic teller machines (ATM, "bankomat" in Slovak, pl. "bankomaty") are widely available in Slovakia except in smaller villages

money.en: A few places, such as smaller museums, coffee shops and churches, still do not accept cards, so carrying some cash is worthwhile.
money.es: Algunos lugares, como museos pequeños, cafés e iglesias, aún no aceptan tarjetas, por lo que conviene llevar algo de efectivo.
money.quote: It's worth carrying some cash, as a few places (smaller museums, coffee shops, churches in particular) still don't accept cards as of 2026.

money.en: Tipping is not compulsory in Slovakia but is common in cafes and restaurants, by rounding up or leaving around 10%.
money.es: La propina no es obligatoria en Eslovaquia pero es habitual en cafés y restaurantes, redondeando o dejando cerca del 10%.
money.quote: Tipping is not compulsory in Slovakia, but in practice it is common in establishments where you sit in (cafes and restaurants), where rounding up the bill or leaving around 10% tip is common.

etiquette.en: Most people do not wear outdoor shoes indoors, so take your shoes off in the hallway when entering a home.
etiquette.es: La mayoría no usa dentro de casa los zapatos de la calle, así que descálzate en el pasillo al entrar en una vivienda.
etiquette.quote: Most people do not use their outdoor shoes inside for hygienic reasons, so take your shoes off in the hallway when entering somebody's home.

etiquette.en: It is considered polite to bring a small gift for a host, but never money.
etiquette.es: Se considera educado llevar un pequeño regalo al anfitrión, pero nunca dinero.
etiquette.quote: It is considered polite to bring a small gift for the host, such as a bottle of wine or good spirit, a box of chocolates, or a small bouquet of flowers, but never give money

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage advises not to refer to Slovakia as part of another state or to confuse it with Slovenia.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage aconseja no referirse a Eslovaquia como parte de otro estado ni confundirla con Eslovenia.
etiquette.quote: Do not refer to Slovakia as a part of another state, or get it mixed up with the similar-sounding Slovenia

etiquette.en: The use of the Nazi salute is a criminal offence in Slovakia.
etiquette.es: El saludo nazi es un delito en Eslovaquia.
etiquette.quote: the use of the Nazi salute is a criminal offence.

connectivity.en: Coverage from the three major networks, Slovak Telekom, Orange and O2, is mostly excellent across the country.
connectivity.es: La cobertura de las tres grandes redes, Slovak Telekom, Orange y O2, es en general excelente en todo el país.
connectivity.quote: Cellular network coverage of the three major networks (Slovak Telekom, Orange, and O2) is mostly excellent throughout the country.

connectivity.en: With an unlocked phone, prepaid cards are easy to pick up in any phone shop.
connectivity.es: Con un teléfono desbloqueado, las tarjetas de prepago se consiguen fácilmente en cualquier tienda de telefonía.
connectivity.quote: If you have an unlocked phone, these are easy to pick up in any phone shop

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi and broadband can be found more or less everywhere in Slovakia.
connectivity.es: Se encuentra wifi y banda ancha prácticamente en todas partes en Eslovaquia.
connectivity.quote: Wi-Fi and broadband can be found more or less everywhere
